claim_boundary: This is a diagnostic exact-errata preflight. It performs no CSPRNG call, marker creation, seed/key generation, signature, authoritative formal-root generation, M3 gate advancement, or state transition.

evidence: The M3RunGenesisV1 array names exactly 15 run-produced root slots.
Section 14.2 requires all 16 run-produced output slots to be null.
The existing implementation and regression test also enumerate 15.

options.decision: Declare the listed 15 slots authoritative and correct the prose count.
options.impact: No wire field is added; existing listed order remains stable.

options.decision: Name, type, position, and semantics of a sixteenth slot.
options.impact: Changes M3RunGenesis bytes and requires new vectors/schema versioning.

exact_errata_blockers.title: M3RunGenesis lists 15 output slots while Gate 24 says 16

evidence: The bridge signature preimage contains execution_manifest_candidate_root.
The published DAG places bridge attestations at step 25 and the execution manifest at step 30.
M3ExecutionManifestV1 itself contains run_id and roots produced in steps 26-29.

options.decision: Generate/register run_id, build the execution candidate, then collect bridge signatures.
options.impact: Preserves the stronger two-root signature message and removes the impossible dependency order.

options.decision: Sign only diagnostic_formal_bridge_root.
options.impact: Weakens execution-specific replay protection and changes the signature preimage.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Bridge signatures precede the execution root they sign

evidence: SignedManifestEnvelopeV1 carries one enclosed root but the bridge signature covers two roots.
The text does not choose one three-signature envelope versus three one-signature envelopes.
Neither M3ExecutionManifestV1 nor M3RunGenesisV1 binds the bridge attestation bundle root.

options.decision: Add a bridge-statement object containing both roots, use three purpose-specific one-signature envelopes, and bind their bundle into run identity.
options.impact: Makes every signature and key purpose independently replayable.

options.decision: Extend SignedManifestEnvelopeV1 to carry both roots and exactly three signatures.
options.impact: Requires envelope schema/version changes and a single epoch policy.

exact_errata_blockers.title: The 3-of-3 bridge statement has no unique envelope identity

evidence: SignedManifestEnvelopeV1 is referenced by signed_envelope_root but has no root formula/domain.
M3DualReplayAgreementV1 has a schema but no ContentHash domain.
A raw SHA-256 guess would violate the project's domain-separated identity policy.

options.decision: Assign explicit ContentHash domains to both formal objects.
options.impact: Matches the existing formal identity convention.

options.decision: Use SHA-256 over canonical CBOR without a domain.
options.impact: Creates a policy exception and must be explicitly frozen.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Required envelope and agreement roots lack hash domains

evidence: ActorKeyManifestV1 roots are not transitively bound by execution/genesis identity.
The pinned custodian and bridge attester trust-anchor source is unspecified.
It is unclear whether the custodian manifest signer is the purpose-1 bridge key.
SignedManifestEnvelopeV1 names custodian_key_epoch even for auditor/attester use.

options.decision: Treat purpose 1 as the same custodian identity for domain-separated manifest and bridge signatures; bind all actor-key roots in a trust-genesis bundle.
options.impact: Uses one custodian key without cross-numeric-purpose reuse.

options.decision: Add a distinct custodian-manifest-signer purpose/key and bind it beside the bridge key.
options.impact: Adds a fifth M2.5 actor key and new purpose registry entry.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Actor key roots and signer purposes are not anchored

evidence: Gate 16 requires one genesis record and no access/reveal event.
The custodian must provide the raw seed to Python and Rust calculators via FD 3.
The hidden-artifact registry classifies raw-seed access as event type 2.

options.decision: Define the two calculators as constrained custodian subprocesses rather than independent ledger actors.
options.impact: Preserves genesis-only Gate 16 while retaining implementation diversity.

options.decision: Append two authorized access events and change Gate 16/head predicates.
options.impact: Changes ledger roots, gate semantics, and execution inputs.

exact_errata_blockers.title: FD-3 split replay conflicts with a genesis-only hidden ledger

evidence: AuditedPathBlobRecordV1 tag 0x3210 is absent from the tag registry.
audited_path_set_root and history records have no complete row schemas/order/root rules.
The described history root has no field in ParentManifestAbsenceAttestationV1.
The attestation has one legacy source digest while odd and sink currently have distinct legacy source IDs.

options.decision: Define path, history, and legacy-source rows plus a versioned audit-bundle root referenced by a revised absence attestation.
options.impact: Binds the complete audit without overloading existing root meanings.

options.decision: Define audited_source_tree_root/audited_path_set_root as composite trees that include history and both source IDs.
options.impact: Avoids a new top-level object but requires exact heterogeneous row tagging.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Parent-history and two legacy sources lack one auditable wire

evidence: M3StateId.NOT_RUN is 0 while ChildInitialStateId.NOT_RUN is 1.
M3RunGenesisV1.initial_state_id does not name which registry applies.
role_id appears in split, target, role-binding, and receipts without a TargetRoleId registry.
ArtifactRoleId describes artifact classes and cannot safely be assumed to be target roles.

options.decision: Bind M3RunGenesis.initial_state_id to M3StateId and add TargetRoleId {OUTSIDE=1,NULL=2}.
options.impact: Separates execution roles from artifact-role IDs.

options.decision: Use ChildInitialStateId and reuse selected ArtifactRoleId values for target roles.
options.impact: Avoids an enum but couples unrelated namespaces.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Target role and M3RunGenesis initial-state bytes are ambiguous

evidence: HiddenArtifactScope has prose/YAML but no formal schema/domain.
Canonical AST/CBOR profile, Phase-2B contract, and MDL table roots lack a unique preimage object.
Implementation source/dependency roots and StateMachineContract legal-transition rows are incomplete.
The inherited M3RunState example conflicts with the common [version, tag, schema_id] prefix.
InputSignatureSpec.static_role_metadata has no nested payload schema.
TraversalContract and BucketAccountingContract field IDs/invariants have no registries or nested schemas.
TargetSpecFormal.claim_level_id and MismatchRecord.mismatch_kind_id have no enum registries.
SplitContract.assignment_ordering_rule_id and fallback_split_policy_id have no numeric registry.
Many profile/order/fallback *_id_digest values lack one exact machine-ID catalog.
The literal repository path 'Hegel Machine/...' contains a space forbidden by IdDigestV1 syntax.

options.decision: Add formal preimage schemas plus one machine-ID/path-alias registry; bind a legal ASCII alias to raw repository path bytes.
options.impact: Preserves IdDigestV1 and makes every named root replayable.

options.decision: Use raw path byte strings for path fields and explicitly reuse normative-document roots for named profile roots.
options.impact: Requires field/schema changes and explicit role-to-document mapping.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Several named roots and machine-ID instances still lack exact preimages

evidence: AppendOnlyOpaqueIdRegistryV1 is named but has no file/wire/root definition.
Gate 24 requires the run ID to be fresh and registered.
No execution/genesis field binds evidence for the project-wide duplicate scope.

options.decision: Define registry rows/root and bind the current registry root into genesis qualification.
options.impact: Makes freshness independently replayable.

options.decision: Freeze an external one-file-per-ID O_EXCL registry and a verifier scan over published identities.
options.impact: Provides operational safety but needs an exact evidence receipt for Gate 24.

exact_errata_blockers.title: Fresh run/ledger IDs have no replayable registry evidence

evidence: Section 4.6 names DslRoleBindingManifestV1.required_witness_ast_hash.
DslRoleBindingManifestV1 has no such field.
TargetSpecFormalV1 and TargetBundleV1 already contain witness-hash slots.

options.decision: Correct the prose to bind the witness in the two existing target fields.
options.impact: No wire change; role binding reaches it through semantic_spec_formal_root.

options.decision: Add required_witness_ast_hash to a new DslRoleBinding schema version.
options.impact: Changes role-binding roots and downstream execution identity.

evidence: The DAG requires final CustodianBindingManifestV1 plus a signature envelope.
The inherited exact one-signature guard names only seed commitment, seed continuity, and ledger genesis.
Envelope-root binding locations for all custodian signatures remain incomplete.

options.decision: Require one pinned custodian signature for tags 0x3103, 0x3105, 0x3106, and 0x3108 and bind all envelope roots.
options.impact: Matches the published topology and makes final custody replayable.

options.decision: Keep signatures only on the inherited three objects and correct the topology.
options.impact: Leaves final custodian binding authenticated only transitively/self-consistently.
